issue: कुम्कुमा: the word is कुमकुमा (a squirt of saffron water); Drik Panchang writes it with a virama. Same sound; not changed without a witness.
our reading: कुम्कुमा (as printed) = कुमकुमा, saffron water sprinkled by the cowherds.

issue: नगदात: one word in Drik Panchang; read as नग (jewels) + दात (gift)?
our reading: नगदात (as printed): gifts of jewels to all.

issue: दुन्दुभि बाजत बहु जात: बहु जात read as 'of many kinds' (जाति), parallel to बहु भाँत in stanza 2.
our reading: kettledrums of many kinds are sounding

issue: नाचत गोप कुम्कुमा छिरकत देत अखिल नगदात: the subject of छिरकत and देत is taken as the cowherds.
our reading: the cowherds dance, sprinkle saffron water and give gifts of jewels to all

issue: ससि-काँत: शशिकान्त is the moonstone or the night lotus in Monier-Williams; the line needs the moon outshone by the face.
our reading: the lovely moon is put to shame
